concerns.text: The plan asserts that “All citations point to the verified HuggingFace URL(s) listed in the “Verified datasets” block; no unverified URLs are used,” yet the primary dataset `codeparrot/github-code` is explicitly noted as **not** being in the verified list. This contradicts Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) which requires every external citation to be verified. The dataset citation must be either replaced with a verified code dataset or the claim of full verification must be corrected.
